selected_evidence.requirement: Persistent firewall permits SSH and TCP/8080 while rejecting unrelated inbound connections
selected_evidence.summary: Runtime and permanent zones show explicit REJECT with only SSH and TCP/8080 allowed. Direct pre- and post-restart tests accepted ports 22 and 8080 while rejecting a live service on 8081.

selected_evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel remain unchanged
selected_evidence.summary: Both baseline and post-restart evidence show RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64.

Baseline boot ID was 21972395-6444-42bf-8e37-5c3108194a7d; the safe reboot was acknowledged; recovered boot ID was 8384da27-f5e6-4b28-a1ff-1dbdb951a84d. firewalld and sshd recovered active/enabled, persistent policy was restored, and direct allow/reject behavior passed after restart.

commands.command:
set -eu
TEST_NS=fwtestns
HOST_IF=fwtest0
PEER_IF=fwtest1
PIDS=''
cleanup() {
  for p in $PIDS; do kill "$p" 2>/dev/null || true; done
  firewall-cmd --zone=public --remove-interface="$HOST_IF" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  ip netns del "$TEST_NS" 2>/dev/null || true
  ip link del "$HOST_IF" 2>/dev/null || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
ip netns add "$TEST_NS"
ip link add "$HOST_IF" type veth peer name "$PEER_IF"
ip link set "$PEER_IF" netns "$TEST_NS"
ip addr add 192.0.2.1/30 dev "$HOST_IF"
ip link set "$HOST_IF" up
ip netns exec "$TEST_NS" ip addr add 192.0.2.2/30 dev "$PEER_IF"
ip netns exec "$TEST_NS" ip link set lo up
ip netns exec "$TEST_NS" ip link set "$PEER_IF" up
firewall-cmd --zone=public --add-interface="$HOST_IF" >/dev/null
python3 -m http.server 8080 --bind 192.0.2.1 >/tmp/fwtest-8080.log 2>&1 & PIDS="$PIDS $!"
python3 -m http.server 8081 --bind 192.0.2.1 >/tmp/fwtest-8081.log 2>&1 & PIDS="$PIDS $!"
sleep 1
printf '%s\n' '--- host test listeners (both exist) ---'
ss -lntp '( sport = :8080 or sport = :8081 )'
printf '%s\n' '--- independent ingress tests from network namespace ---'
ip netns exec "$TEST_NS" python3 - <<'PY'
import socket
for port in (22, 8080, 8081):
    try:
        s = socket.create_connection(("192.0.2.1", port), timeout=3)
        if port == 22:
            proof = s.recv(128).decode("ascii", "replace").strip()
        else:
            s.sendall(b"GET / HTTP/1.0\r\nHost: firewall-test\r\n\r\n")
            proof = s.recv(128).decode("ascii", "replace").splitlines()[0]
        print(f"TCP/{port}: ACCEPTED: {proof}")
        s.close()
    except OSError as e:
        print(f"TCP/{port}: REJECTED: {e.__class__.__name__}: {e}")
PY
printf '%s\n' '--- effective zone during ingress test ---'
firewall-cmd --get-zone-of-interface="$HOST_IF"
firewall-cmd --zone=public --list-all
cleanup
trap - EXIT
rm -f /tmp/fwtest-8080.log /tmp/fwtest-8081.log
printf '%s\n' '--- cleanup proof ---'
ip netns list | grep -F "$TEST_NS" && exit 1 || true
ip link show "$HOST_IF" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 1 || true
[ ! -e /tmp/fwtest-8080.log ]
[ ! -e /tmp/fwtest-8081.log ]
echo 'temporary test resources removed'

  ip netns del "$TEST_NS" 2>/dev/null || true

import socket

    try:
        s = socket.create_connection(("192.0.2.1", port), timeout=3)
        if port == 22:
            proof = s.recv(128).decode("ascii", "replace").strip()
